question: Do ingress features (payload bytes, image pixels, row counts) predict handler duration better than the job key alone?
size_bins: floor(log2(primary size feature)), per key; keys without a size feature use per_key_median; bins with fewer than 20 training samples fall back to the key median

gradient_boosting.features: job key (categorical) + log1p of every numeric ingress feature

decision.binned_feature_worthwhile: per_key_size_bin_median lowers median_abs_log2_error by at least 0.25 versus per_key_median AND raises tier_accuracy by at least 5 percentage points, in at least 5 of the 6 runs
decision.richer_model_worthwhile: gradient_boosting lowers median_abs_log2_error by at least a further 0.25 versus per_key_size_bin_median in at least 5 of the 6 runs
decision.otherwise: per-key statistics are sufficient for this workload
